tagline: One mouse and keyboard for every computer on your desk
brief: A free, open-source tool that shares one mouse and keyboard across macOS, Windows and Linux computers. It should feel fast, precise, calm and quietly confident, and show what it does at a glance.
criteria: Readable as 'one pointer moving between computers' at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, amber as the only accent.

concepts.name: Crossing
concepts.idea: A laptop and a monitor with one amber pointer on the seam between them: one mouse and keyboard, crossing to the next computer.
rationale: Says what the app does in one glance, at any size
Pixel-fitted 16, 22 and 24 px drawings keep both computers in the tray
Amber appears only on the pointer, the same signal the app uses for live state

recommendation: Crossing: final artwork, icons and tray states delivered in docs/brand/.
next_steps: Swap the tray drawing in crates/tray/src/icon.rs using tray-geometry.md
Ship the app icons with the packages
Use tokens.css in the app window
